title: Delta Review Scorecard — Inheritance Rules, Workload Reduction, and Review Classification
purpose: Measure the effectiveness of delta review — the Framework v2 mechanism that skips unchanged items using SHA-256 content hashing. Framework v1 re-reviewed 100% of items every wave, even though 80% were unchanged. Framework v2 targets a 77% workload reduction by inheriting certification decisions for unchanged items.

delta_review_architecture.description: Delta review uses SHA-256 content hashing to determine whether an item has changed since its last certification. Unchanged items inherit their prior certification decision (CertifiedDelta) with zero re-review time. Only changed items receive full or partial review.

hash_types.content_hash: SHA-256 over Stem + Choices[A-D] + CorrectChoice + ExplanationCorrect + ExplanationWrong[A-D] (trimmed, whitespace-normalized, keys sorted)
hash_types.metadata_hash: SHA-256 over Difficulty + DifficultyScore + CognitiveLevel + LOSTag + Topic + Section + SectionName
hash_types.identity_hash: SHA-256 over the 6-field compound key string

change_classifications.CONTENT_CHANGE: content_hash differs from baseline → requires full re-audit
change_classifications.METADATA_CHANGE: metadata_hash differs, content_hash same → requires psychometric review only
change_classifications.PRESENTATION_CHANGE: identity fields changed, content same → rare, usually path changes
change_classifications.NO_CHANGE: all hashes match baseline → CertifiedDelta, no review needed
change_classifications.UNCLASSIFIED: item not in baseline → requires full audit (new item)

inheritance_rules.description: Five inheritance rules (IR-001 through IR-005) determine the review scope for each change classification. These rules encode the delta review decision logic.

rules.name: Unchanged → CertifiedDelta
rules.condition: content_hash matches baseline. Delta classification = NO_CHANGE. No new scan findings on this item.
rules.action: Inherit prior certification decision. Zero review time. Item retains 'Certified' status without re-examination.

rules.name: EW-Only Change → Targeted Review
rules.condition: content_hash differs but only ExplanationWrong fields changed. Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect unchanged.
rules.action: Quality Board reviews only the changed EW fields. Structural integrity (DL-008/DL-026) verified on changed slots only. ~2 minutes per item.

rules.name: Metadata Change → Psychometric Review
rules.condition: metadata_hash differs but content_hash same. Difficulty, CognitiveLevel, or LOSTag changed.
rules.action: Review the metadata change for psychometric consistency. Verify difficulty calibration. ~2 minutes per item.

rules.name: Content Changed → Full Re-Audit
rules.condition: content_hash differs. Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, or ExplanationCorrect changed.
rules.action: Full re-audit: all CAQS dimensions, all structural gates, all content-quality scans. ~8 minutes per item.

rules.name: Conservative Override — New Scan Finding on Unchanged Item
rules.condition: content_hash matches baseline but a new defect scanner (added after the item was certified) flags a finding.
rules.action: Review the new scan finding only. Do not re-open the full item audit. If finding is confirmed, item moves to REMEDIATE. If false positive, reject the finding and retain CertifiedDelta status. ~3 minutes per item.
rules.target_volume: ~1-2% of items (rare — only when new defect scanners are added)

DR-001_full_reviews.description: Items requiring full re-audit (IR-004: content changed). These are the most expensive review type.
DR-001_full_reviews.formula: full_reviews = items with CONTENT_CHANGE delta classification
DR-001_full_reviews.v1_baseline: 100% of items (all 500 per wave received full review)
DR-001_full_reviews.rationale: IR-004 handles content-changed items (expected ~3%) plus a buffer for edge cases

DR-002_partial_reviews.description: Items requiring targeted review of specific changed fields (IR-002: EW-only, IR-003: metadata).
DR-002_partial_reviews.formula: partial_reviews = items with METADATA_CHANGE or EW-only CONTENT_CHANGE
DR-002_partial_reviews.v1_baseline: 0% (Framework v1 had no partial review — everything was full review)
DR-002_partial_reviews.rationale: IR-002 (~10% EW-only changes) + IR-003 (~4% metadata changes) + buffer

DR-003_inherited_reviews.description: Items that retain CertifiedDelta status with zero review time (IR-001: unchanged).
DR-003_inherited_reviews.formula: inherited = items with NO_CHANGE delta classification that pass IR-001
DR-003_inherited_reviews.v1_baseline: 0% (delta review did not exist in v1)
DR-003_inherited_reviews.rationale: 80% of items are unchanged between waves per S200 Agent I assessment

DR-004_skipped_reviews.description: Items where unchanged content has a new scan finding requiring targeted review (IR-005).
DR-004_skipped_reviews.formula: skipped_but_reviewed = items with NO_CHANGE content but new scan finding
DR-004_skipped_reviews.v2_target: <2% of items (rare — only when new scanners deploy)

workload_reduction.label: Workload Reduction — v1 vs. v2 Review Effort
workload_reduction.description: The primary value proposition of delta review: reducing the per-wave review workload by skipping unchanged items. Framework v1 spent 600 minutes per 100 items. Framework v2 targets 61 minutes — a 90% reduction per the S203 engineering estimate. The S202 architecture target is a 77% overall workload reduction.

v1_effort.unchanged_items: 80 items × 8 min = 640 min (but v1 re-reviewed all 100)
v1_effort.total: 100 items × 8 min = 800 min (but practical average ~600 min per S203 estimate — some items reviewed faster)

v2_effort.ew_only_partial: 10 items × 2 min = 20 min (IR-002 targeted EW review)

per_100_items_model.reduction_pct: 90% (600 min → 61 min per 100 items, per S203 engineering estimate)
per_100_items_model.framework_target: 77% overall workload reduction (S202 target — includes board consolidation savings beyond delta review alone)

measurement_points.per_wave_delta_review_reduction: Compare review minutes spent vs. what v1 would have spent on the same items
measurement_points.per_wave_total_reduction: Delta review reduction + board consolidation reduction + pre-flight reduction
measurement_points.cumulative_reduction: Running total from S202 baseline through current phase

delta_ledger_metrics.label: Delta Ledger Operational Metrics
delta_ledger_metrics.description: The DELTA_LEDGER.json stores content/metadata/identity hashes for every item. These metrics track ledger health.

DLM-001_ledger_coverage.v2_target: 100% — every item must have a delta ledger entry

DLM-002_hash_stability.description: Percentage of items whose content_hash is identical across two consecutive Delta Ledger builds on the same pack file. Non-deterministic hashing breaks delta review.
DLM-002_hash_stability.v2_target: 100% — canonical serialization must produce deterministic hashes

DLM-003_ledger_freshness.description: Age of the most recent Delta Ledger build. Stale ledgers cannot accurately classify changes.
DLM-003_ledger_freshness.v2_target: <1 session — ledger must be rebuilt at every session T0

current_operational_status.label: Delta Review at S322/S350
current_operational_status.status: INFRASTRUCTURE_BUILT — Delta Ledger Builder (scripts/delta_ledger_builder.js) operational. Baseline hashes computed for all 2,540 items. No historical baseline to compare against yet — all items classified as UNCLASSIFIED.
current_operational_status.first_baseline: S322 delta ledger serves as the T0 baseline. Future sessions will detect changes vs. this baseline.
current_operational_status.readiness_for_phase_2: Delta review infrastructure is built and self-test passing. Activation requires: (1) at least one completed certification wave to establish a change baseline, (2) Phase 2 Shadow Mode authorization at S830.

measurements.notes: Delta ledger baseline established. All 2,540 items classified as UNCLASSIFIED. No inheritance possible until second certification wave.
First measurement of delta review effectiveness after at least one certification wave under Framework v2.

measurements.target: Skip rate >75%, re-review rate <25%, workload reduction >77%
measurements.notes: Full delta review effectiveness. 80% of items should be CertifedDelta, zero re-review.
